preregistration: D-352 (3) (the pooled scoring of D-332 (5) P-A3.1 to P-A3.4); D-352 (2) (an infeasible band undefined); D-332; D-177; D-244 (6); D-322 (4); D-351 (3)

preregistration_text.text: (3) POOLED A3 SCORING, PRE-REGISTERED NOW (a separate script with three reviewers, written before any per-pair A3 record is read; the A3 lane logs print check and verdict words only): P-A3.1: cells = pair x pool (R_same, R_fresh, 1% traffic) x attacker (A3-top, A3-benign) x rho (the 8 grid values) = 48 per pair, 432 over the nine pairs; per cell realised = the D-156 mean over draws of the seed-mean TPR, predicted = the same of the predicted TPR; D-177's accuracy line (share within x1.5, median |log(realised/predicted)|, n cells; zero predictions are misses, D-322 (4)); the VERDICT line is all 432 cells against D-332's expectation of 80%; beside: the quantile-transfer cells alone (144) and the threshold re-set cells alone (288; agreement there is mechanical). P-A3.2 (A3-benign's minimum rho >= A3-top's): a (pair, pool, repair) cell is decided unless both minimum rhos are '> 0.25' (D-244 (6)); the pooled verdict 'in every pair and pool' HOLDS if every decided cell holds and at least one is decided, FAILS if any decided cell fails, is UNDEFINED if none is decided; counts of decided, holding, failing and undecided cells reported. P-A3.3: per pair as (2) (a pair fails if any decided cell fails, holds if every decided cell holds and one is decided, else undefined); pooled 'in every pair' by the same rule over pairs, with the number of infeasible cells and each pair's clean-pool flag share beside. P-A3.4 (restandardisation's minimum rho >= 10 x A3-top's of each score repair): the same pooling rule; it carries no new measurement (A3-top equals 4d B's A1 bit for bit, D-322). The self-anchor stays per pair (D-332 (6)).

P-A3.1.miss: a zero predicted (or realised) TPR: an infinite error, outside x1.5, inside the median (phase3_a3.accuracy; D-322 (4))

P-A3.3.rule: A3-band's TPR loss at its largest m < A3-top's at the same m (phase3_a3.p33_cell)

P-A3.4.rule: restandardisation's minimum rho >= factor x A3-top's of each score repair (phase3_a3.at_least)

config.pooling_rule: D-352 (3): HOLDS if every decided unit holds and at least one is decided, FAILS if any decided unit fails, UNDEFINED if none is decided (phase3_a3.decided_verdict; D-351 (3)'s reading)

code.one_code_block: the nine A3 records' code sha256 maps and library versions identical; commits listed

choices: (a) P-A3.1's cells are phase3_a3.score's per-cell rows: the pool's score repair (threshold re-set on R_same and R_fresh, quantile transfer on traffic; phase3_a3_predictions choice (b); restandardisation is P-A3.4's), realised and predicted as cell D-156 means (D-332 (5)). The accuracy line is phase3_a3.accuracy unchanged: a zero predicted TPR is a miss (D-322 (4)), and so is a zero realised TPR (its |log| is infinite; D-346 (2) as phase3_a3 applies it); both counts are stated. The expectation (at least 80% within x1.5) is tested on the verdict line only, as D-352 (3) registers it for the 432 cells; the two beside lines report their accuracy lines with no expectation_met.

(b) Binding and re-derivation (D-351 (1)'s binding, extended): each pair's 48 P-A3.1 cells are checked one by one, the realised TPR from the A3 npz and the predicted TPR from the predictions npz, exactly as phase3_a3.score derives them, against the A3 record's per-cell rows; then each A3 record's cells, minimum-rho table, A3-band outcomes, health flag shares and scoring are recomputed from its npz by phase3_a3.summaries, min_rho_table, band_outcomes and score (with the predictions npz and the record's threshold-identity counts), and each predictions record's 'predicted' block by phase3_a3_predictions.predicted_cells from its npz; each must equal the record's, the D-282 interval blocks aside (they need the eval positives' scores from the caches). The pooled lines use the re-derived values.

(c) D-352 (3) pools P-A3.2 over (pair, pool, repair) cells, P-A3.3 over pairs and P-A3.4 by 'the same pooling rule'. For this rule the verdict over cells equals the verdict over the pairs' own verdicts (a decided cell fails exactly when a pair fails; a decided cell exists exactly when a pair is decided); a test proves it exhaustively on small grids. P-A3.4's verdict is computed over its 27 (pair, score repair) cells, P-A3.3's over its nine pairs (each pair's verdict by the same rule over its four cells); every line reports the other reading beside with its counts.

(d) P-A3.2's cells include restandardisation on traffic (four per pair, 36; phase3_a3 choice (n)); P-A3.4's are the three score repairs per pair (27; phase3_a3 choice (o)); P-A3.3's the four (pool, repair) cells per pair (phase3_a3 choice (m)).

(e) One code block, commits listed (A1's choice (f), D-351 (1); D-352 (6)): the nine A3 records' code sha256 maps and library versions are identical, and each predictions record's code block names src/phase3_a3_predictions.py and gives the A3 block's sha256 on each of its files, with the same libraries. The 18 records' commits may differ and are listed: D-352 (6) allows a relaunch, or a later half, at another SYNC_COMMIT that keeps every phase3_a3.CODE_FILES sha256. src/phase3_a3.py and src/phase3_a3_predictions.py in the records and in this tree are the reviewed blobs (REVIEWED_SHA256: the files at ee5ad0c; this scorer calls their functions); any other code file that differs from this tree is listed.

(f) The self-anchor stays per pair (D-332 (6)): each A3 record's anchor must be checked and identical, with no minimum-rho or value mismatch, all ANCHOR_N (148, phase3_a3.anchor_check's count) values identical, the four minimum-rho comparisons equal, against the 4d B record of record (populations.POOLSTUDY_D156), and its A3-top minimum rhos equal to the re-derived ones; its implementation checks (threshold identity, band) held. A record that fails any refuses the whole scoring.

(g) D-170: each pooled line carries the per-pair flag the A3 records store (input_verification.flag) and its number of flagged cells; D-331 made D-168 final and its pinned record clears the flag of the judged pin-only inputs. No flagged or unflagged sub-line is formed (none is pre-registered).

(h) Beside P-A3.3 (D-352 (2), (3)): the infeasible cells with their reasons, each pair's clean-pool Gaussian flag share per pool (phase3_a3.band_outcomes), D-352 (2)'s finding cells, and each cell's loss comparison over only the draws with m > 0, all from the re-derived per-pair blocks. Beside P-A3.2: each pair's benign_fit_row_share_per_seed (the confound with a direction, D-352 (2)).
(i) The pooled lines are printed only after the record is written (D-351 (1)); D-352 (3)'s 'check and verdict words only' governs the per-pair A3 lane logs, before any pooled scoring exists.

self_anchor.rule: per pair (D-332 (6)); every pair's anchor passed, else the scorer refuses (choice (f))

P-A3.1.cells: pair x pool x attacker (A3-top, A3-benign) x rho, the pool's score repair (phase3_a3.score's per-cell rows, re-derived): realised = the D-156 mean over the draws of the seed-mean TPR, predicted = the D-156 mean over the draws of the seed-mean predicted TPR F1bar(t')
P-A3.1.accuracy_line: D-177 (phase3_a3.accuracy): share within x1.5, median |log(realised/predicted)|, n cells; a zero predicted (or realised) TPR is a miss and counted (D-322 (4))
